news.title: TheatreUNI presents “The Language Archive” by Julia Cho
news.summary_en: TheatreUNI will present “The Language Archive” – a fast-paced, modern tragi-comedy with an essence of magical realism, written by Julia Cho.

news.title: UNI’s Our Tomorrow campaign raises record $342.8 million
news.summary_en: Since 2018 when the University of Northern Iowa quietly launched Our Tomorrow: The Campaign for UNI, more than 34,000 donors have helped to expand opportunities for students, strengthen programs and build lasting support for UNI’s future.
